name: WdFieldKind
description: Specifies the type of field for a Field object.

constants.name: wdFieldKindNone
constants.description: An invalid field (for example, a pair of field characters with nothing inside).

constants.name: wdFieldKindHot
constants.description: A field that's automatically updated each time it is displayed or each time the page is reformatted, but which can also be manually updated (for example, INCLUDEPICTURE or FORMDROPDOWN).

constants.name: wdFieldKindWarm
constants.description: A field that can be updated and has a result. This type includes fields that are automatically updated when the source changes and fields that can be manually updated (for example, DATE or INCLUDETEXT).

constants.name: wdFieldKindCold
constants.description: A field that does not have a result, for example, an Index Entry (XE), Table of Contents Entry (TC), or Private field.
